description: A standard micro servo motor that moves to an angular position based on a PWM control signal.
how_to_use: PWM is the control signal (a bit-banged digital pulse, not a shared bus). V+ needs real 5V, not a toggling GPIO pin — wiring V+ to a digital pin instead of 5V is a common diagram-authoring mistake this checker won't catch, since it only judges connectivity, not electrical sanity.
